Product description

The Vivo T4 5G is designed for users who want powerful performance, stunning visuals, and exceptional battery life in one stylish device. Featuring a large 6.77-inch immersive display, it delivers crisp clarity and vibrant colors, making it ideal for streaming, gaming, and everyday browsing. Powered by the advanced Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 5G processor and supported by 8GB RAM, the phone ensures smooth multitasking, fast app launches, and efficient performance. Capture sharp and stable photos with the 50MP OIS rear camera, while the 32MP front camera provides detailed selfies and clear video calls. The massive 7300mAh battery is built for extended usage, keeping you connected throughout the day with minimal charging interruptions. Finished in the premium Emerald Blaze color, the Vivo T4 5G combines elegance with reliability, making it a perfect choice for modern smartphone users
